messages:
noah: spinning up nebula-int4 canary. early post-onboard runs show structured funcall failures ~1.9% vs 0.2% float baseline. attaching representative snippets.

noah: bad sample (raw):
```
{"tool":"create_invoice","payload":{"amount":120.00,"currency":"USD","items":[...]}}
PS: promo logic deferred to billing team
```

maya: trailing "PS:" breaking JSON parse. interesting that model appends a human note. only on nebula-int4 and when KV-prefix > ~1k tokens.

alex: could be tokenizer boundary + eos token confusion after quantized decoding. tried extracting first JSON object with a brace-match parser and it fixed ~70% of these. quick snippet I used: `def grab_json(s): stack=0; start=None; for i,c in enumerate(s): if c=='{': stack+=1; start=start or i; elif c=='}': stack-=1; if start is not None and stack==0: return s[start:i+1]`

taylor: watch out: heuristics + retries => duplicate side-effects. `create_invoice` is non-idempotent. we saw 12 duplicate invoices in a 10k sample when naive retry was on.

noah: proposal: 1) add `idempotency` metadata to tool manifest (`idempotent` or `non-idempotent`), 2) change default retry policy to `safe-only` for canary, 3) implement two-stage sanitizer: `heuristic-extract` then `strict-parse` fallback that returns parse error (no retry) for non-idempotent tools.

maya: +1. also add sanitizer telemetry: fields `raw_output`, `extracted_json`, `sanitizer_action` (heuristic|trim|fail). we'll need this for post-mortem.

alex: mini-experiment: batch sizes -> parse error rates: batch=1 -> 1.2%, batch=4 -> 1.9%, batch=12 -> 3.3%. continuous batching seems to increase suffix chatter.

taylor: tradeoff table makes sense. for nebula-int4 canary set batch=3 and mirror 7% of traffic. rollback rule: if sanitized_rate > 0.4% AND dup_effect_rate > 0.01% then abort.

noah: devx note: can we get a short example snippet and recommended defaults for tool manifests? e.g., `{"name":"create_invoice","idempotency":"non-idempotent","retry_policy":"none"}` to put in docs.

devx: yep i'll add a blurb + sample manifest to onboarding docs. prefer a small section titled "Tool idempotency & retries".

maya: i'll own the eval: running `eval/nebula/funcall-50k-20260204`. will validate sanitized_count, duplicate_effects, and latency impact. ETA 90m.

alex: i'm landing a sanitizer PR with `--sanitize-mode=off|heuristic|strict` and verbose logs. link: https://git.internal/r/nebula/sanitize (draft). default=heuristic.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: nebula-int4 canary -> 2026-02-04T18:00:00Z (4h window). mirror=7%, batch=3, rollback_conds set.

noah: good. action items: alex PR + telemetry, maya eval run, taylor canary config, devx doc blurb. reconvene after eval job finishes or ~3h post-canary start. :thumbsup:

alex: one more: add synthetic negative tests that append common suffixes ("PS:", "Note:", "– billing") into CI to catch regressions.

maya: adding tests now.

noah: thanks team. closing thread for now but will post results. :party_parrot:
